prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D dark fantasy VFX ANIMATION sprite sheet. Exactly SIX columns and FOUR rows (24 cells), landscape. One coherent effect per row, six successive hand-painted animation frames left to right, not six unrelated designs. Columns: 1 small ignition/first stroke; 2 rapidly forming; 3 full developed attack; 4 changed flowing/flaming shape at full power; 5 breaking apart; 6 scattered fading particles. A genuine progression of contours, internal motion, debris and energy, not a single picture scaled. Projectiles point RIGHT, fixed head location across frames 2-4, moving inner texture and trailing wisps. Ground eruptions share identical bottom-center origin, grow upward and dissipate. Keep the camera, palette, pixel scale, anchor and effect identity stable within each row. Every cell has wide empty margins; no overlap, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no characters, no landscape. Crisp readable painterly luminous contours, textured dark cores, restrained glow. Genuinely transparent alpha background, NOT black or checkerboard. Rows top to bottom: violet fractured void crystal bolt; cyan abyss water lance; magenta sonic ring projectile; orange burning coal projectile.

body_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D side-scrolling dark-fantasy monster SPRITE ANIMATION ATLAS on genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly SIX EQUAL columns by FOUR EQUAL rows, 24 separate full-body sprites. Wide transparent gutters; absolutely no overlap across cells. One character per row; same design and fixed scale throughout its six frames. All face RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Every frame planted at same baseline. Six columns in exact order: idle; walk left leg forward; walk right leg forward; crouched anticipation; attack extension; recovery. Row 1: small stocky burgundy horned cave imp, pale claws, ochre eyes, no weapons. Row 2: compact charcoal armored ash fiend with ember cracks and burnt-orange crest, clawed limbs, no weapons. Row 3: squat gnarled bark Root Stalker with branch antlers, moss mantle and amber eyes, root feet; attack pose presses clawed hand into ground to summon roots but no huge root effect included. Row 4: compact cyan crystal and corroded-bronze sentry turret creature on stubby stone feet, central round crystal eye/muzzle facing right; columns2 and3 idle eye/petal variations, column4 eye retracts charging, column5 eye opens releasing, column6 plates settling. Painterly detailed textures, readable silhouettes, crisp edges, no text, no grid, no UI, no terrain, no background illumination, no shadows below feet. Transparent surrounding space, no black or checkerboard backdrop. Keep every limb inside its own cell.

extraction_attempt.prompt: Edit target: this 6-column 4-row game animation sheet. Background extraction ONLY. Remove the entire colored gradient background and all diffuse background illumination, make it genuinely transparent alpha. Preserve exactly all 24 foreground sprites, their existing shapes, cell locations, six columns and four rows, colors, details and dimensions. No new art. No black backdrop, no checkerboard. Only the discrete painted sprite shapes and attached sharp wisps should remain visible, all surrounding space completely transparent. Preserve dark cores. This is a production transparent sprite atlas, not a poster.
